description: Reads the Content-Security-Policy header of a site's home page and lists weak points: 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval' in script sources, bare wildcards, data: or http: script sources, a missing default-src or script-src, and a missing policy altogether. Reports directives. Header only; a CSP in a meta tag is not read. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_csp_evaluator_audit
title: Security Csp Evaluator Audit
